note: Wurtzite ZnMgO FE needs very high coercive fields; nvSRAM-style shadow backup applied to DRAM idle states.
Tail leakage is random per cell, so pairs rarely leak equally; gain likely below claimed 10-30x.
Close to known bistable floating-body holding schemes (Zeno-style) restoring whole arrays via bias pulses.
Stepwise/adiabatic charge recycling is known; on-pitch reservoir area and timing eat most of the claimed 6-8x.
Growing 100 uniform MoS2/hBN pairs and edge-contacting each 1.5 nm-pitch monolayer individually both need miracles; storage element unaddressed.
p-type Cu2O mobility and matching too poor for sense amps; moving periphery over array is the right target.
Same as I-04778 with SnO/ZTO; SnO is the better p-oxide but still weak for matched sense amps.
Area-selective ALD is widely pursued industry-wide; selectivity defects are the known limiter.
Echoes refresh-free eDRAM for short-lived DNN data (RANA); guaranteeing retention against the leakage tail is the crux.
Known TFT-LCD trick; only reproduces shadows of buried metal, so few tier features can use it.
Slit-etched track edges still pin domain walls; if shifting works, ~16 bits per pillar per tier is a real density jump.
Dual-relief imprint for dual damascene has prior art; core is NIL replacing EUV on periodic arrays.
Resist-free self-aligned layers via ASD; widely pursued, water framing is the only new angle.
1e-4 pillar defect rate means ~1e6 defects per die; sparing overhead may exceed the EUV savings.
Same core as I-04751: arrays above and below one periphery layer; nano-TSV per bitline group is the hard part.
Ultra-high-AR {111} KOH walls are proven in MEMS; novel as DRAM channel sheets, but capacitor placement is unaddressed.
ThruChip-style inductive links are demonstrated; coil area and power delivery still need TSVs.
Gain transistor per 16-cell local bitline lets ~0.5 fF cells sense, easing the capacitor wall; doubts are TFT Vt mismatch and write-back.
CBA/periphery-on-separate-wafer is widely pursued for 3D DRAM and NAND; 400 nm subarray bonding is aggressive.
Supply-chain strategy: no prime wafers or EUV for array tiers; IGZO DRAM retention/speed still TRL 3-4.
Targets the passing-gate row-hammer mechanism at zero area; needs a DRAM fab to prove.
Mat-granular hybrid-bonded DRAM on compute cuts transport energy >10x; widely pursued, thermal and yield coupling are the doubts.
Essentially Sunrise Memory's quasi-volatile NOR; thin-oxide charge-trap endurance (~1e10-1e11) falls short of DRAM-class.
Metal/bond options for organization already standard; 2T2C SKU is a modest extension.
Port of production dual-workfunction buried-WL GIDL fix to lateral 3D cells, self-aligned via the storage hole.
40 nm pitch is below the 213/193 nm two-beam interference limit; needs pitch-splitting from ~70-100 nm; throughput doubtful.
Through-tier vias cannot reach bitline pitch without muxing; amortizing periphery over 8 bonded array wafers is the insight.
Each wordline plate gates channels above and below; ~1.5x tiers per etch depth.
Column redundancy/bad-block maps are standard; tolerating 1% bad cells per mat is the twist.
Same as I-00628; 1e15 contact cycles far beyond demonstrated NEMS relay endurance.
Self-aligned turn-down via inside each lateral tier is hard; net ~1.4x density per etch depth.
Bubble-memory loop architecture with deposition-only skyrmion tiers; pinning, small-size thermal stability and readout are the doubts.
Voltage stacking known in logic; activity balancing across DRAM tiers and level shifting are the risks.
Self-aligning write, read and storage of a 2T cell with only two line masks is very constrained.
Multimaterial fiber draw to ~50 nm coax with intact thin glass wall is unproven; geometry gives ~1.5 fF/um, enough.
DEP placement cannot reach DRAM pitch and yield over billions of sites per tier.
Spatial ALD is commercial; 3D stacks are mostly PECVD already, so gain is modest.
Overlapping storage nodes without isolation share charge; random reads would disturb neighbors.
CNT-electrode DRAM caps explored ~2000s; at DRAM pad pitch a forest is a few tubes, and conformal ALD inside is hard.
Sense amps from array devices sacrifice matching and PMOS; the water claim really comes from stacking.
Angled IBE at 20:1 in oxide is immature and the geometric area gain from leaning plates is marginal.
N+1 die stack with worst tier disabled; same spare-layer remap idea as I-00148.
Twist on RRS/SRS row-swap defenses riding on refresh; full re-keying each window costs bandwidth.
Backside capacitor frees the 4F2 front for bitlines; ~1.5x density and thermal decoupling.
uTP is commercial; tiny dielets limit capacity per placement and I/O density.
Multi-energy SIMOX gives only 2-4 thin tiers with degraded crystal between BOXes.
Same as I-04751 (vertical folded pairing); single-crystal layer transfer over capacitors strains thermal budget.
Same core as I-05207; series bitline charge reuse needs matched activity across tiers.
Deep-defect charge-state bits; capture/emission speed and single-defect read variability are the key doubts.
Bitline vias crossing each bond need sub-100 nm bond alignment; module binning is the clever part.
Invensas BVA-style wire forests are known; 25 um wires give far lower bandwidth than HBM.
Double layers in 2-3 nm solid electrolytes likely respond in us-ms, not ns, with self-discharge.
Same as I-04769 with proton/Li conductors; ionic response time is the blocker.
Backside contacts land directly on S/D, leaving little room for a memory tier; needs a leading-edge fab.
Anodic TiO2 tubes are too wide, defective and leaky for DRAM pitch; self-ordering will not register to pads.
Registration-free AAO pores are clever, but TiN/ZrO2/TiN stack nearly fills 25 nm pores; known in silicon capacitors.
Resembles layer-selection-by-multilevel in 3D NAND; Vt variation limits tiers per gate pair.
R2R pitch (~um) yields bits/area orders below DRAM; cost per bit unlikely to win.
Fine-grained activation known (half-DRAM, SALP); 3D stack absorbs the second gate's area.
Shifting every bit each ~1 us costs enormous energy at GB scale; ECC-per-lap concept is neat.
Porous-Si oxidation (FIPOS) carves many crystalline tiers without SiGe strain limits; boron diffusion and expansion stress are risks.
Very close to Kilopass VLT / T-RAM; thermal sensitivity and standby current are known issues.
Staggered per-tier trenches require patterning each tier, adding masks that undercut the cost benefit.
CCD-style shift columns give many bits per 4F2 hole; multi-phase gates, transfer efficiency and clock power are the doubts.
Chipkill-style parity ported to 3D tiers; parallel 9-tier activation costs power.
Bitline-clamped charge-transfer presensing is 1990s DRAM art.
Spare tiers with remap table; monolithic tier defects are local, so mat-level remap matters more.
Fiber devices exist at micron scale; nanoscale gated transistors with end-addressing over km fibers need a miracle.
Strain gives 90-degree rotation; deterministic low-error 180-degree switching remains unsolved.
F2F pairs halve TSVs; ~10-15% bits per wafer.
Bottle-trench lineage; multiple bulbs per neck need ALD to pass the neck without pinch-off.
Cerebras-style wafer-scale with WoW memory; well-trodden direction.
Same as I-02020; MLCC-style lamination of TFT sheets; ~100 nm F limits density.
Per-core hybrid-bonded DRAM tiles cut transport energy >10x; widely pursued (SoIC/WoW); thermal and yield coupling are doubts.
At DRAM pitch the well is only ~1-2 gyroid periods, and TiN/high-k/TiN cannot fit a 20 nm network.
Kirkendall shells are poor dielectrics and inner-wall electrode access is unclear; ~1.8x area.
NIL for periodic layers is under evaluation by memory makers; defectivity and overlay limit it.
Soft PDMS stamps and mask-aligner overlay cannot meet DRAM overlay at 15 nm.
Tunnel-SRAM revival; III-N epitaxy is not BEOL-compatible and per-cell valley current kills standby.
SAB is known; room-temperature Cu/SiO2 hybrid bonds are weak without anneal.
Arrays bonded to both faces of a periphery wafer share sense amps with a matched reference bitline.
Nano-velcro Cu nanowire bonding is commercial (NanoWired); rework helps stack yield.
Capacitorless floating-body in released Si tiers resembles NEO X-DRAM; FBC retention scaling is the core doubt; back-gate is the twist.
alpha-In2Se3 FeS-FETs are widely studied; endurance far from DRAM-class.
Building DRAM periphery in accelerator logic removes base die; 3 nm devices cannot drive boosted wordline voltages.
Same as I-00139 through a deposited gate stack; serial access and clock energy are the doubts.
Very demo-able with MPW plus cleanroom; logic-transistor leakage and coarse post-processing litho cap density.
Driven-plate sensing is known (FeRAM, boosted DRAM schemes); segmenting the plate costs area.
BCP DSA with SIS hardmasks is demonstrated research; defectivity has blocked adoption.
Backside low-R bitlines and body tie fix VCT's historical problems; backside alignment at 4F2 pitch is hard.
Same as I-03373; statistical pad landing removes alignment.
Wafer-on-wafer DRAM with a spare wafer and bank remap; through-wafer vias still needed.
FSA of chiplets is known; panel RDL wiring limits bandwidth.
Thickness-defined CDs is the 3D NAND recipe; poly-Si channels leak far too much for DRAM retention.
NEMS DRAM was proposed before; 1e15 contact endurance and stiction are unsolved.
Monolayer doping (Javey) is proven; conformal doping of 100-tier sidewalls is a sensible application.
